title: Klartex Recipe
description: Schema for YAML recipe files that define composable document templates

title.description: Jinja expression for the document title (rendered with data context)

page_template.description: The recipe's default page template as a slot object ({"header": …, "footer": …}), which may also carry a 'margins' object (faktura and kvitto: 2cm left/right, 1.7cm top). Omit for the recipe default (the letterhead header and the page-number footer with the document title). data.page_template overrides per slot at render time. A footer slot object may carry a 'fields_from' map — footer field name to a dot-path into the payload data, or to a list of dot-paths whose set values become the field's lines — resolved at render time and merged under whatever the payload's footer of the same variant sets, key by key. 'fields_from' and a literal 'fields' cannot sit on the same slot object. data.page_template.margins overrides the default margins one key at a time; a custom header or page-template source that sets no \geometry of its own receives them.

label_missing_footer_fields.description: true names the gaps in the columns footer instead of dropping the column: a column without content prints a muted label ('Adress saknas', 'Org.nr saknas', 'Betalningsuppgifter saknas'). Applies to every columns footer this recipe renders, whether the fields are derived or supplied by the payload.

label.description: Display label for the metadata field

field.description: Dot-notation path into the data object

optional.description: If true, skip this row when the field is missing

suffix_fields.description: Additional data fields appended to the value (e.g. time_start, time_end)

metadata.description: Metadata fields displayed in a table at the top of the document

data_map.description: Mapping from component parameter names to dot-notation data paths

options.description: Static options passed to the component

components.description: Ordered list of components to render in the document body

content_fields.description: Mapping of content field names to their types

schema.description: Relative path to JSON Schema file for template data validation
